node.title: E1 class-difference square-mass coordinates and finite height
node.statement: For signed singleton vectors x,y representing two antipodal-rearrangement classes, alpha=sum_i(x_i-y_i)zeta^i has square mass S=4a+b and height H=2a+b. If T=min(ell,2h-ell), then H<=2T and even S<=4T. Raw same-sign antipodal-pair padding changes representative distance but not alpha. At the official parameters S<=260 for N=256,ell=65 and S<=132 for ell=33. Every S=16 split with b>0, namely (3,4),(2,8),(1,12),(0,16), is realized by official-size N=256 class pairs and survives the present norm floor; the existing variance descent covers only (3,4). This reparametrization closes no collision ledger or prize row.
node.notes: CANONICAL RECONCILIATION 2026-07-28: preserves the square-mass insight of prize 0acf7e8f and the N=512 correction c90a724b, repairs the false fixed-order unboundedness wording, pins the formerly missing ell bound, and proves the three additional S=16 splits are genuine feasible class-pair profiles.
